from xml.sax.handler import feature_external_ges from xml.dom import pulldom SMALL_SAMPLE = '\n\n\nIntroduction to XSL\n
\n

A. Namespace

\n' def _t(): parser = pulldom.parseString(SMALL_SAMPLE) saxparser = parser.parser ges = saxparser.getFeature(feature_external_ges) assert ges == False, ('assertEqual', ges, False) try: _t() except BaseException as _e: print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e))) else: print('ok')

from xml.dom import pulldom

def _t():
    """Ensure SAX2DOM expands nodes as expected."""
    sax2dom = pulldom.SAX2DOM()
    sax2dom.startDocument()
    sax2dom.startElement('doc', {})
    sax2dom.characters('text')
    sax2dom.startElement('subelm', {})
    sax2dom.characters('text')
    sax2dom.endElement('subelm')
    sax2dom.characters('text')
    sax2dom.endElement('doc')
    sax2dom.endDocument()
    doc = sax2dom.document
    root = doc.documentElement
    text1, elm1, text2 = root.childNodes
    text3 = elm1.childNodes[0]
    assert text1.previousSibling is None, ('assertIsNone', text1.previousSibling)
    assert text1.nextSibling is elm1, ('assertIs', text1.nextSibling, elm1)
    assert elm1.previousSibling is text1, ('assertIs', elm1.previousSibling, text1)
    assert elm1.nextSibling is text2, ('assertIs', elm1.nextSibling, text2)
    assert text2.previousSibling is elm1, ('assertIs', text2.previousSibling, elm1)
    assert text2.nextSibling is None, ('assertIsNone', text2.nextSibling)
    assert text3.previousSibling is None, ('assertIsNone', text3.previousSibling)
    assert text3.nextSibling is None, ('assertIsNone', text3.nextSibling)
    assert root.parentNode is doc, ('assertIs', root.parentNode, doc)
    assert text1.parentNode is root, ('assertIs', text1.parentNode, root)
    assert elm1.parentNode is root, ('assertIs', elm1.parentNode, root)
    assert text2.parentNode is root, ('assertIs', text2.parentNode, root)
    assert text3.parentNode is elm1, ('assertIs', text3.parentNode, elm1)
    doc.unlink()
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
